examples.english: The new agricultural scheme is a cooperative venture among farmers in South Wales.
examples.persian: طرح کشاورزی جدید یک همکاری مشترک بین کشاورزان ولز جنوبی است.

miniContext: Agricultural means connected with the practice of farming.

examples.english: It is a cooperative venture among farmers in South Wales.
examples.persian: این یک طرح مشترک بین کشاورزان ولز جنوبی است.

miniContext: Cooperative means doing sth together or working together with others towards a shared aim.

examples.english: It would be logical to extend it to the whole of Wales.
examples.persian: منطقی است که آن را به کل ولز گسترش دهیم.

miniContext: Logical means seeming natural, reasonable or sensible.

examples.english: The company has become increasingly profitable in recent years.
examples.persian: شرکت در سال‌های اخیر روزبه‌روز سودآورتر شده است.

miniContext: Profitable means that makes or is likely to make money.

examples.english: It makes very simple functional clothes which are hard-wearing.
examples.persian: لباس‌های ساده و کاربردی تولید می‌کند که دوام زیادی دارند.

miniContext: Functional means practical and useful; with little or no decoration.

examples.english: These houses are affordable.
examples.persian: این خانه‌ها مقرون‌به‌صرفه هستند.

miniContext: Affordable means cheap enough that people can afford it.

examples.english: The army worked throughout the night to put up protective barriers.
examples.persian: ارتش تمام شب برای برپاکردن موانع محافظتی کار کرد.

miniContext: Protective means providing or intended to provide protection.

examples.english: The destructive force of the storm has still caused considerable damage.
examples.persian: نیروی مخرب طوفان همچنان خسارت زیادی وارد کرده است.

miniContext: Destructive means causing destruction or damage.

examples.english: There was some structural damage.
examples.persian: خسارت سازه‌ای هم وارد شده بود.

miniContext: Structural means connected with the way in which sth is built.

examples.english: It's a forward-thinking company with lots of progressive ideas.
examples.persian: این شرکتی آینده‌نگر با ایده‌های پیشرو است.

miniContext: Progressive means in favour of new ideas and modern methods.

examples.english: Hundreds applied for places, but the company are very selective.
examples.persian: صدها نفر درخواست دادند، اما شرکت خیلی گزینشی است.

miniContext: Selective means careful about what or who you choose.

examples.english: They need to strengthen the bridge.
examples.persian: باید پل را مستحکم‌تر کنند.

miniContext: Strengthen means to make sth/sb stronger.

examples.english: This story will weaken the President's position.
examples.persian: این خبر موقعیت رئیس‌جمهور را تضعیف خواهد کرد.

miniContext: Weaken means to make sb/sth less strong or powerful.

examples.english: We need to maximize our efficiency.
examples.persian: باید کارایی‌مان را به حداکثر برسانیم.

miniContext: Maximize means to increase sth as much as possible.

examples.english: They specialize in computer technology.
examples.persian: آن‌ها در فناوری رایانه تخصص دارند.

miniContext: Specialize means to be or become an expert in a particular area of work or study.

examples.english: The government must stabilize the currency.
examples.persian: دولت باید ارز را تثبیت کند.

miniContext: Stabilize means to become or make sth become firm and steady.

examples.english: We have to clarify the situation.
examples.persian: باید وضعیت را روشن کنیم.

miniContext: Clarify means to make sth clearer and easier to understand.

examples.english: This story will intensify speculation.
examples.persian: این خبر حدس‌وگمان‌ها را تشدید خواهد کرد.

miniContext: Intensify means to increase or make sth increase in degree and strength.

examples.english: We need to simplify the rules.
examples.persian: باید قوانین را ساده کنیم.

miniContext: Simplify means to make sth easier to do or understand.

examples.english: You must specify your name in full.
examples.persian: باید نام کامل خود را دقیقاً مشخص کنی.

miniContext: Specify means to state sth giving an exact measurement, time, instruction, etc.
